visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged woman wearing a blue apron with 'TEAPOT' text, a black lace shirt, and a large orange bow on her head stands behind a metal counter. She holds a large metal pot and pours dark brown liquid through a long fabric tea strainer into another metal pitcher. The background shows shelves stocked with beverage ingredients and equipment. (2) The woman picks up a white squeeze bottle with a red cap and pours a thick white syrup into a glass mug already containing a dark liquid. She then uses a metal spoon to scoop a white powder from a green bowl into the same mug. (3) The woman vigorously stirs the dark brown mixture in the glass mug with a long metal spoon. Her hands are covered in white gloves, and her movements are quick and practiced. Several other glass mugs and metal containers sit on the counter in front of her. (4) The woman reaches into a blue plastic ice bin to scoop ice cubes into a clear plastic bag. She holds the bag open with her gloved hand as she fills it. In the background, a white board with Thai writing and yellow menus is visible on the wall. (5) She pours the prepared tea mixture from the glass mug into the plastic bag filled with ice. Then, she takes a metal can of evaporated milk and pours a generous amount directly into the bag, creating a swirl of white and brown. (6) A younger woman with long dark hair, wearing a black tank top and a leopard-print skirt, receives the drink packaged in a colorful paper holder with the word 'Coffee' on it. She stands on a busy city street with shops and passers-by visible in the background. (7) The younger woman holds the drink up to the camera, smiling and talking. She takes a sip through a orange straw, exhibiting a joyful facial expression. She holds the bag by its plastic handles, demonstrating the convenience of the packaging while walking along the sidewalk.
